basic_info.description: Sophisticated and serene, a gem of a property in exclusive Presidio Heights. Enjoy three bedrooms and three baths, all en suite, with vaulted ceilings, an open social kitchen with Carrara counters and the finest appliances, beautiful hardwood floors, and views of the central courtyard full of green foliage throughout the home. Large walk-in closets, In-unit washer dryer, a generous parking space, and a gas fireplace in the living room round out this unique and wonderful opportunity.
